accroche.texte: Claudeception turns every hard-won solution from Claude Code into a skill that reloads on its own
passages: When Claude Code discovers something non-obvious (a debugging technique, a workaround, some project-specific pattern), it saves that knowledge as a new skill.
Next time a similar problem comes up, the skill gets loaded automatically.

description.texte: An hour on an obscure error, the agent finally finds the fix, the session closes, and next time it all starts over. With Claudeception, the debugging technique, workaround, or project quirk discovered along the way becomes a skill, loaded automatically as soon as a similar problem comes back.
passages: You spend an hour debugging some obscure error, the agent figures it out, session ends. Next time you hit the same issue? Another hour.

interet.texte: It sorts: only what required real research, will be reused, has a clear trigger, and actually worked becomes a skill. And the description is written to be found again: the exact error, not "database issues".
passages: The skill is picky about what it extracts.
It only extracts knowledge that required actual discovery (not just reading docs), will help with future tasks, has clear trigger conditions, and has been verified to work.
it writes a new skill with a description optimized for future retrieval
"Helps with database problems" won't match anything useful.

exemple_usage.texte: Example from the repository: a resolved PrismaClientKnownRequestError (too many connections in serverless) can become a skill whose description reuses the exact error. When it reappears, the agent finds it again.
passages: Fix for PrismaClientKnownRequestError: Too many database connections in serverless environments (Vercel, AWS Lambda).

termes_proches.raison: Claudeception donne à Claude Code une forme de mémoire : les solutions trouvées restent sous forme de skills, pas un historique des conversations.
Claudeception vise un agent qui progresse en travaillant, en écrivant ses propres skills.
Claudeception peut constituer au fil du temps une bibliothèque de skills propre à l'utilisateur ou au projet.
le dépôt présente Claudeception comme un méta-skill, un skill qui sert à acquérir d'autres skills.
Claudeception n'est pas un outil de débogage : il retient les solutions trouvées pendant le débogage pour les réutiliser.
Claudeception s'adresse aux agents de code comme Claude Code, pour qu'ils gardent d'une session à l'autre les solutions trouvées.
la rétrospective de session de Claudeception peut transformer un retour d'expérience en skill réutilisable.
